parts.text: $IT Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, -1% Y/Y, with the decrease primarily due to the sale of the Digital Markets business. Operating margin 18.7%. #earnings #industrials
$PACS Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, +12% Y/Y, driven by facility acquisitions and transitional care growth. Operating margin 6.7%; operating cash flow $211M. #earnings #healthcare
$ECG Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.4B, +40% Y/Y, driven by electrical and mechanical segment growth and data center demand. Operating margin 8.8%; net earnings $92M. #earnings #industrials
$MCY Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, -13% Y/Y, with an operating margin of -1.7% as operating costs outpaced revenue. Net loss reached $14M, while operating cash flow stood at $387M. #earnings #insurance
$ADT Q3 2026: revenue $1.3B, +4% Y/Y, driven by installation and product growth from the ADT+ platform transition. Operating margin 23.0%; net earnings $151M. #earnings #industrials
$TLN Q3 2026: revenue $1.3B, +63% Y/Y, driven by higher generation volumes from recent acquisitions and increased capacity prices. Operating margin 19.2%. #earnings #utilities
$WMK Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.3B, +3% Y/Y, driven by higher fuel sales and new stores despite pharmacy pricing headwinds. Operating margin 2.2%; net earnings $22M. #earnings #retail

$KNF Q3 2026: revenue $1.3B, +6% Y/Y, supported by public-sector contracting and aggregate volume growth. Operating margin was 16.8% as costs outpaced sales growth amid competitive bidding. #earnings #mining
$TPG Q3 2026: revenue $1.2B, flat Y/Y, with management fees comprising 47% of total revenue. Operating margin reached 26.4% and operating cash flow was $249M. #earnings #finance
$MTDR Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.2B, +24% Y/Y, driven by record production and improved natural gas realizations from the new pipeline. Operating margin 30.4%. #earnings #oil
$ECHO Q3 2026: revenue $1.1B, down 69% Y/Y as service revenue dropped. Net earnings reached $2.8B, driven by non-operating items from debt actions. #earnings #media

$FBIN Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.1B, -3% Y/Y, driven by lower water sales and portfolio actions. Operating margin 5.4%; operating cash flow $347M. Guides Q4 net sales to $925M–$995M. #earnings #materials
